title: Deduction of tax at source on benefit or perquisite in respect of business or profession
plainTextSummary: Any person responsible for providing to a resident any benefit or perquisite, whether convertible into money or not, arising from business or the exercise of a profession, shall ensure that tax has been deducted at source at the rate of 10% of the value or aggregate of value of such benefit or perquisite, provided the value exceeds ₹20,000 in the financial year. Where the benefit is wholly in kind or partly in kind, the person providing it must ensure that tax is paid before releasing the benefit.

keyStatutoryThresholds.providerTurnoverPrerequisite: Turnover > ₹1 Cr (business) or > ₹50L (profession) in preceding FY for individuals/HUFs. Companies/LLPs have no turnover floor.
keyStatutoryThresholds.benefitScope: Covers free samples above de minimis, foreign/domestic dealer incentive trips, sponsor gifts, hotel accommodations, and capital assets transferred without adequate consideration per CBDT Circular 12/2022.

officialCitations.subject: Guidelines under section 194R of the Income-tax Act, 1961 - Benefit or perquisite in respect of business or profession

requiredDocumentChecklist: Fair market value invoice / valuation report for benefits provided in kind
Proof of advance tax / ITNS 281 challan if tax was discharged in cash prior to benefit release
Recipient Permanent Account Number (PAN) validation record
Company annual dealer / channel incentive scheme documentation
